source: GitHub public REST API; cached responses are reused on rerun
selection: 100 most recently updated eligible closed type:bug reports matched against 2,000 recently updated closed PRs
quality_rules: Merged PR with explicit closing reference
At least 350 characters and 55 whitespace-separated words
Remove HTML comments and template checkboxes
Exclude duplicate labels and not_planned closures
Unique issue IDs and normalized descriptions; reject description similarity >= 0.92
resolution: Factual merged PR title, with full cleaned PR description retained; no inferred root cause
limitations: Single-repository convenience sample, not an exhaustive duplicate detector. Upstream issue and PR text may change.
